items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025

ctx.x: I can’t recognize the tune but it’s obviously Toots. Is it from that Brazilian project album or is it –
You are absolutely correct. It’s Toots with Quincy Jones from the album “Walking in Space.”

“Walking in Space.” Yeah. Oh Quincy loved Toots. I mean, and I got to meet Toots and play with him a few times too. And of course you know he played the chromatic with the button on it. And was very intrigued and kind of like puzzled by like why I was playing chromatically on a diatonic. But we got along real well. And yeah Toots was a genius, a musical genius who just so happened to play the harmonica and give his gifts to the instrument. But the thing about him musically was that he started on accordion and he…
